name: tree-copy
description: Generates a visual ASCII directory tree with file icons, respecting .gitignore/.ignore rules, and copies output to clipboard.

systems.windows: cwm save -t util -t file -d "Generates visual ASCII directory tree to clipboard" tree-copy "& { `$root = (Get-Location).Path; `$rules = @('*.git*', '.git\*'); foreach (`$f in @('.gitignore', '.ignore')) { `$p = Join-Path `$root `$f; if (Test-Path `$p) { `$rules += Get-Content `$p | Where-Object { `$_ -match '\S' -and !`$_.StartsWith('#') } | ForEach-Object { `$clean = `$_ -replace '^/','' -replace '/+$',''; `"`$clean`", `"`$clean\*`", `"*`$clean`", `"*`$clean\*`" } } }; Split-Path `$root -Leaf; Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Where-Object { `$rel = `$_.FullName.Substring(`$root.Length + 1); `$skip = `$false; foreach (`$r in `$rules) { if (`$rel -like `$r) { `$skip = `$true; break } }; !`$skip } | Sort-Object FullName | ForEach-Object { `$rel = `$_.FullName.Substring(`$root.Length + 1); `$parts = `$rel -split '[/\\]'; `$indent = '|   ' * (`$parts.Count - 1); `$icon = if (`$_.PSIsContainer) { '[DIR]  ' } else { '[FILE] ' }; `$name = `$_.Name; Write-Output `"`$indent|-- `$icon`$name`" } } | Set-Clipboard; Write-Host 'Visual tree copied to clipboard!' -ForegroundColor Green"
systems.linux: cwm save -t util -t file -d "Generates visual ASCII directory tree to clipboard" tree-copy "bash -c 'basename \"$PWD\"; git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard | sort | while read -r file; do depth=$(tr -dc \"/\" <<< \"$file\" | wc -c); indent=$(printf \"|   %.0s\" $(seq 1 $depth)); name=$(basename \"$file\"); if [ -d \"$file\" ]; then icon=\"[DIR]  \"; else icon=\"[FILE] \"; fi; echo \"${indent}|-- ${icon}${name}\"; done | xclip -selection clipboard; echo -e \"\033[0;32mVisual tree copied to clipboard\033[0m\"'"
systems.mac: cwm save -t util -t file -d "Generates visual ASCII directory tree to clipboard" tree-copy "zsh -c 'basename \"$PWD\"; git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard | sort | while read -r file; do depth=$(tr -dc \"/\" <<< \"$file\" | wc -c); indent=$(printf \"|   %.0s\" $(seq 1 $depth)); name=$(basename \"$file\"); if [ -d \"$file\" ]; then icon=\"[DIR]  \"; else icon=\"[FILE] \"; fi; echo \"${indent}|-- ${icon}${name}\"; done | pbcopy; echo -e \"\033[0;32mVisual tree copied to clipboard\033[0m\"'"

scripts.linux:
#!/bin/bash
ROOT_DIR="${1:-.}"
ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$ROOT_DIR" && pwd)"
ROOT_NAME="$(basename "$ROOT_DIR")"

PIPE="│   "
BRANCH="├── "
FOLDER_ICON="📁 "
FILE_ICON="📄 "

OUTPUT="$ROOT_NAME\n"

build_tree() {
    local dir="$1"
    local depth="$2"

    local entries=()
    if command -v git &>/dev/null && git -C "$dir" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree &>/dev/null; then
        while IFS= read -r file; do
            [ -n "$file" ] && entries+=("$file")
        done < <(git -C "$dir" ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard "$dir" | awk -F/ '{print $1}' | sort -u)
    else
        while IFS= read -r -d '' item; do
            local name="$(basename "$item")"
            [[ "$name" =~ ^(\.git|\.ignore|\.gitignore)$ ]] && continue
            entries+=("$name")
        done < <(find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -print0 | sort -z)
    fi

    local dirs=()
    local files=()
    for entry in "${entries[@]}"; do
        local full_path="$dir/$entry"
        if [ -d "$full_path" ]; then
            dirs+=("$entry")
        else
            files+=("$entry")
        fi
    done

    local indent=""
    for ((i=0; i<depth; i++)); do indent="${indent}${PIPE}"; done

    for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
        OUTPUT="${OUTPUT}${indent}${BRANCH}${FOLDER_ICON}${d}\n"
        build_tree "$dir/$d" $((depth + 1))
    done

    for f in "${files[@]}"; do
        OUTPUT="${OUTPUT}${indent}${BRANCH}${FILE_ICON}${f}\n"
    done
}

build_tree "$ROOT_DIR" 0

if command -v xclip &>/dev/null; then
    echo -e "$OUTPUT" | xclip -selection clipboard
    echo -e "\033[0;32mVisual tree copied to clipboard (xclip)!\033[0m"
elif command -v xsel &>/dev/null; then
    echo -e "$OUTPUT" | xsel --clipboard
    echo -e "\033[0;32mVisual tree copied to clipboard (xsel)!\033[0m"
else
    echo -e "$OUTPUT"
    echo -e "\033[0;33mNotice: Install xclip/xsel to auto-copy tree to clipboard.\033[0m"
fi
scripts.mac:
#!/bin/zsh
ROOT_DIR="${1:-.}"
ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$ROOT_DIR" && pwd)"
ROOT_NAME="$(basename "$ROOT_DIR")"

PIPE="│   "
BRANCH="├── "

OUTPUT="$ROOT_NAME\n"

build_tree() {

    local depth="$2"

    local entries=()
    if command -v git &>/dev/null && git -C "$dir" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree &>/dev/null; then
        entries=(${(f)"$(git -C "$dir" ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard "$dir" | awk -F/ '{print $1}' | sort -u)"})
    else
        for item in "$dir"/*(D); do
            local name="$(basename "$item")"
            [[ "$name" =~ ^(\.git|\.ignore|\.gitignore)$ ]] && continue
            entries+=("$name")
        done
    fi

    local dirs=()
    local files=()
    for entry in "${entries[@]}"; do
        [ -z "$entry" ] && continue
        local full_path="$dir/$entry"
        if [ -d "$full_path" ]; then
            dirs+=("$entry")
        else
            files+=("$entry")
        fi
    done

    local indent=""
    for ((i=0; i<depth; i++)); do indent="${indent}${PIPE}"; done

    for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
        OUTPUT="${OUTPUT}${indent}${BRANCH}${FOLDER_ICON}${d}\n"
        build_tree "$dir/$d" $((depth + 1))
    done

    for f in "${files[@]}"; do
        OUTPUT="${OUTPUT}${indent}${BRANCH}${FILE_ICON}${f}\n"
    done
}

build_tree "$ROOT_DIR" 0

echo -e "$OUTPUT" | pbcopy
echo -e "\033[0;32mVisual tree copied to clipboard (pbcopy)!\033[0m"
